cases.question: How many annual leave days do full-time employees get?
cases.answer:
Northstar Labs is a fictional company. These policies are original demonstration data, not employment or legal advice. Full-time employees receive 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Part-time employees receive a pro-rated allowance based on contracted working days. Public holidays do not reduce the annual leave allowance. [S1]

An employee may carry over up to 5 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year. Carried-over days expire on 31 March of that next year. People Operations maintains the authoritative leave balance in PeopleDesk; this policy does not contain individual balances. [S2]

cases.question: What are the hotel and meal reimbursement caps for business travel?
cases.answer:
Book economy-class flights. Hotel reimbursement is capped at USD 180 per night before tax. Meals are reimbursed at actual cost up to USD 60 per travel day, including tax and tips. Alcohol is not reimbursable. Unused daily meal allowance cannot be carried to another day. [S1]

Obtain Finance approval before incurring an expense above a stated cap. Approval of a trip does not automatically approve an above-cap hotel or meal. This policy does not authorize upgrades or personal-travel costs. [S2]

cases.question: What is the first-response target for a Severity 1 support case, and is it a resolution promise?
cases.answer:
Include the organization name, affected function, observed impact, start time, and safe diagnostic details in the case. Do not include passwords, API keys, or authentication tokens. If a case exceeds its first-response target, request escalation in the existing support case rather than creating duplicate cases. No 24/7 coverage, guaranteed resolution time, or contractual service-credit entitlement is specified here. [S1]

Northstar Labs is a fictional company. Customers open support cases in the Atlas support portal. Standard staffed support hours are 09:00–17:00 UTC, Monday through Friday, excluding company holidays. Support response targets describe the first human response, not resolution or restoration time. [S3]

Severity 1 means the production service is unavailable to all users with no viable workaround. The initial response target is 1 staffed support hour. Severity 2 means a major function is unavailable to a subset of users and a workaround exists. The initial response target is 4 staffed support hours. Severity 3 means a general question or minor issue that does not prevent normal work. The initial response target is 2 working days. [S2]
expected_claims: 09:00–17:00 UTC Monday through Friday excluding company holidays
